title: Billing and subscription – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Billing & subscription
hero.lead: This area manages the Kaderblick subscription for teams. It is separate from club funds, the cashbook and personal-account payments.

body:
Check team status

Each card names a team and its current billing status. Depending on the state, Kaderblick also shows the end of the free period, the paid-until date or a reason for restricted access.

  • Free period: the team is still in the displayed trial period.
  • Active: the subscription is running and may show a paid-until date.
  • Pending: a started payment process has not been completed.
  • Overdue, paused, blocked or cancelled: the card shows the state supplied by the billing system and, where available, a reason.
  • Not yet subscribed: the team can be selected under Subscribe.

Subscribe teams

  1. Select the checkboxes for the teams whose payment you want to cover.
  2. Check the monthly total on Select payment method.
  3. Select Select payment method. Kaderblick redirects you to the protected payment process.
  4. Select an offered payment method there and complete the process.

In the verified demo, the Kaderblick page names PayPal, SEPA Direct Debit, card, Apple Pay and Google Pay as possible methods. Which methods are actually offered in the subsequent payment process depends on the device and payment provider.

Continue an interrupted payment

If teams have Pending status, Kaderblick shows Restart payment process instead of a new team selection. This opens a new payment process for the affected teams.

Manage an active subscription

For an existing subscription, a card shows the included teams, monthly total and end of the current billing period.

  • Manage opens the payment provider’s customer portal, which contains the available subscription management actions.
  • Invoices lists recorded payments with date and amount.
  • Open invoice opens the provided invoice or PDF in a new browser window.

If payment is unavailable

If payment integration is not configured for the current Kaderblick instance, the area displays a notice and the buttons for starting payment remain disabled. If all offered teams are already in a trial or active subscription, the page explains their state instead of showing the selector.

Differences by role

  • Club and team cashiers: see teams for which their assignment permits billing administration.
  • Club and team administration: can receive this area if the specific assignment includes billing permission.
  • Players, parents, coaches, equipment managers, media officers and supporters: do not receive billing administration solely through those roles.
  • Super administration: platform billing for all customers is a separate administration area and is not the same as this team view.

Related areas

  • The billable team selection comes from Clubs & teams and your assignments.
  • The Cashbook manages internal income and expenditure; subscription payments are managed here.
